thread:
Sam H.: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: GPU supply + regional fallbacks. A couple ppl asked for concrete flow — here's the list of Qs, please reply inline so I can collate.

Maya (VP Infra): Thanks Sam. We'll take these. Short answers now, follow-up doc tomorrow.

Devon (Capacity PM): Q1: If us-east runs out, do requests go to eu-west or to Dedicated prewarmed pool? What's routing order?

Zhang: Routing priority is: 1) customer pinned Dedicated pools (if configured), 2) same-region sibling cluster, 3) nearest-region fallback (based on latency cost), 4) last-resort dedicated burst. For hosted customers the default is same-region -> nearest-region; we only hit dedicated burst if regional pools are saturated.

Liam-Ops: Are spot instances used for burst at all or only for prewarm/batch?

Zhang: We don't use spot for latency-SLO traffic. Spot machines are for non-critical prewarming and background evals. Production inference uses reserved/ondemand.

Devon (Capacity PM): Q2: Autoscaler behavior — if queue length spikes for 90s, do we spin new pods or route? Need exact thresholds to put in the playbook.

Zhang: Autoscaler config summary: observation window = 90s, scale decision at 2x target qps sustained, scale step = +1 node up to burst_limit. If scale fails due to supply, policy triggers model fallbacks (quantized variants) or reroute based on routing policy. Snippet: ```autoscaler.window=90s
autoscaler.scale_step=1
policy.on_supply_failure=fallback_to_compatible_model_or_reroute```

Maya (VP Infra): Clarify: fallback to smaller model is opt-in per customer by default. For public-hosted apps we will try nearest-region first. We'll add opt-in flags in the Console so teams can prefer consistent outputs over latency.

Sam H.: Good. Cross-region fallbacks came up — is there a residency/privacy blocker we should call out during sales handovers?

Liam-Ops: Yes — Private deployments (VPC / on-prem) never cross-region. Hosted tenants: we annotate any cross-region fallback in audit logs and surface it in the tenant console (flagged for compliance teams).

Devon (Capacity PM): Action items: I'll draft a one-page ops playbook with the routing flow diagram, autoscaler thresholds, and the expected latency deltas per fallback path. @Maya can you review? ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Maya (VP Infra): +1, will review. ops-bot, please create the doc stub. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: created doc stub: https://internal.docs/infra/gpu-fallback-playbook (stub) :white_check_mark:

Sam H.: Thanks all — please add 1–2 bullets to the doc if you called out numbers above (scaling windows, fallback order, residency rules). I'll consolidate and post to the infra-runbook channel when ready.
